_doc: Hand-entered Druid effects (Forever). Tags: cat = Cat Form sources (white/Shred/finishers), tank/bear = Bear Form threat sources, finisher/builder = combo-point abilities, hot/direct = heal parts, form:cat/form:bear for Heart of the Wild stats. mana_share tag shapeshift = mana spent on form changes.

Genesis.note: +1%/rank periodic damage and healing (Moonfire/Rip/Rake DoTs, Rejuvenation/Regrowth HoTs). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 15,30,60): removing it costs 0.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.4%). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-30, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, feral-cat-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 1.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.5%).
